notes.title: Bug fixes, changes - v1.0.0.1r
notes.notes:
Bug fixes: 
- A bug has been fixed where you incorrectly received the achievement 'Money printer' with the €80 in the tutorial

Changes:
- Customers can now be up to 40% more patient (up to 75% in the tutorial) to reduce a bit of stress
- The chance of customers not liking your food and spitting out the food on the way has been drastically reduced
- Customers no longer litter the table as often

notes.title: Kitchen Quest - Release v1.0.0.0r
notes.notes:
Dear Gamers and Food Enthusiasts,

We are thrilled to announce that our highly anticipated culinary adventure, "Kitchen Quest," is now available on Steam!

Step into the world of gourmet cooking and prove your skills as a master chef. In "Kitchen Quest," you can cook over 50 dishes in a fully equipped kitchen, complete with everything a chef needs. But don't forget to make your restaurant appealing before all the guests leave!
Features:

-Perfectly Equipped Kitchen: Your kitchen has everything from simple pans to deep fryers. All the tools you need to bring your culinary dreams to life are at your disposal!
-Variety of Dishes and Ingredients: With over 50 different dishes and more than 100 different ingredients, you can offer everything your customers' hearts desire.
-Kitchen Challenges: Not everything in the kitchen can always run perfectly. Forget to turn the meat, and you could be facing a huge disaster!
-Strict Customer Reviews: The customers in "Kitchen Quest" are very demanding and resent every little thing. If a meal arrives even 1 second too late, the customer is already gone. If a dish doesn't meet their expectations, this will be reflected in the rating—sometimes harshly, sometimes less so.
-Different Types of Customers: Not every customer is that strict. Some will always give you good ratings, while others might just not return.
-Relaxed Sandbox Mode: If all this stress is too much for you, the sandbox mode is perfect! All recipes are available from the start, with no annoying customers leaving at every little mistake and rating you with 0 stars. Just enjoy the stress-free beautification of your restaurant.
-Invite Restaurant Critics: To develop your restaurant further, you can invite a total of 7 different restaurant critics. If the critics like your food, they will share their favorite recipes with you, which you can then sell in your restaurant.

Available Now!

Don't miss the chance to dive into the world of gourmet cooking and manage your own restaurant. "Kitchen Quest" is now available on Steam, waiting to be discovered by you.

Get the game today and show the world that you are the best chef. We look forward to seeing the fantastic dishes you create!

Thank you for your support and happy cooking!

Best culinary regards,

The "Kitchen Quest" Team
